title: Japanese Ochazuke Rice Bowl with Roasted Fennel
description: A simple and comforting Japanese-inspired rice bowl recipe featuring roasted fennel and topped with intensely flavorful ochazuke.
instructions: Cut the fennel bulb in half lengthwise and place on a baking sheet.
Drizzle with 1 tablespoon of sesame oil and season with salt. Roast in the oven for 20-25 minutes, or until tender.
Cook the Japanese short-grain rice according to package instructions.
In a small saucepan, heat the ochazuke over low heat.
In a large bowl, combine the cooked rice, roasted fennel, soy sauce, and sesame oil.
Pour the ochazuke over the rice mixture and toss to combine.
Garnish with chopped green onions and pickled ginger.
